What is TextKit?
:   TextKit is an SMS API for developers and AI agents. One REST API sends and receives texts, verifies phone numbers with one-time codes, and provisions real US and Canadian phone numbers.

Which countries can TextKit text?
:   The United States and Canada. TextKit does not deliver to other countries.

How much does a text cost?
:   $0.002 per text, plus carrier fees at cost ($0.0035 to $0.005 a text, set by the recipient's carrier). Plans start at $0 a month, and failed sends are not charged.

Is there a free plan?

Do I need to register before texting customers?
:   Yes, in the US. A local number needs an approved A2P 10DLC registration before it can text the public, and TextKit files it for you. Carriers usually review in 4 to 5 business days; you can text your own verified numbers meanwhile.

# Transactional SMS API for the US and Canada

TextKit is a transactional SMS API for the US and Canada: receipts, shipping updates, account notices and alerts, sent with one API call at $0.002 per text plus carrier fees at cost. Each text gets a delivery status by webhook, a retried job cannot send twice, and test keys simulate the whole flow for free.

## At a glance [...] Two-way SMSSend by API, take replies as signed webhook events, and answer from the number they texted.
 OTP and phone verificationSend a one-time code and check it in two calls, and pay only when the code is verified.
 Appointment remindersSchedule a reminder per appointment, cancel it if the booking moves, and handle replies by webhook.
 Order and delivery notificationsSend one text per order event with an idempotency key, and track delivery by webhook.
 Alerts and on-call pagingPage by SMS with deduplicated sends, delivery receipts for escalation, and a spend cap for alert storms.
 Two-way supportReceive customer texts in a shared inbox or by webhook, reply through the API, and auto-reply after hours. [...] bash

```
"Authorization: Bearer $TEXTKIT_API_KEY""Content-Type: application/json""Idempotency-Key: order-A-1042-shipped"'{"from":"+15005550100","to":"+15005550006","body":"Acme: your order A-1042 has shipped."}'
```

## Which number should you send from in the US and Canada?

| Sender | US recipients | Canadian recipients | Setup |
 ---  --- |
| US local number | Yes | Yes | 10DLC registration |
| US toll-free number | Yes | Yes | Toll-free verification |

Canadian numbers can be bought but cannot be registered through us yet. See SMS pricing in Canada.

TextKit is an SMS API for the United States and Canada with a hosted MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any AI agent can send texts, verify phone numbers, buy numbers, load contacts, build segments, run broadcasts and set up automations on your account.

The server is ` Streamable HTTP, sign in to connect or pass an API key. Every tool runs in the free sandbox until you go live, where a text costs $0.002 plus carrier fees at cost.

## Connect from Claude [...] ## Connect from ChatGPT

In ChatGPT, open Plugins, select +, then Add custom MCP server, with the URL ` and OAuth, and create it as a plugin. ChatGPT sends you to TextKit to sign in; approve it the same way. This URL has every tool except Verify and API keys: ChatGPT does not allow one-time codes.

Step-by-step guides for Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Cline and more are on the integrations page.

## Add to Replit or Cursor

Add to Replit · Add to Cursor

Both open the app with TextKit filled in; sign in when it asks. In Replit, Agent can then text from the apps it builds: ask it to create an API key with `create_api_key` and store it as the secret `TEXTKIT_API_KEY`.

## Connect with an API key

Any MCP client that can send a header: [...] Any MCP client that can send a header:

```
{ "mcpServers": { "textkit": { "url": " "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer tk_sk_test_..." } } } } 
```

Start with test data: everything runs in the sandbox and no real phone gets a text. Every tool is one API call with your key, so its scopes, rate limits and send checks apply unchanged. To limit what an agent can do, give it a key with only the scopes it needs.

# About TextKit

TextKit is an SMS API for developers in the United States and Canada. One REST API sends and receives text messages, verifies phone numbers with one-time codes, looks up a number's carrier and line type, and rents local numbers. Plans start at $0 a month, and free test keys run every endpoint in a sandbox with no card.

## What does TextKit do? [...] ## What does TextKit not do?

 No voice, WhatsApp or outbound MMS.
 No delivery outside the United States and Canada.
 No live sending before business verification and carrier registration, which we file for you.

## Contact

 Mailing address: 5830 E 2nd St, Ste 7000, PMB 35111, Casper, WY 82609, USA
 Phone: (251) 347-1073
 Email: support@jointextkit.com
 Contact form: jointextkit.com/contact

One mailbox receives everything, including support, billing, legal, privacy and abuse reports, and a person reads every message.

## The name

The product was called SimpleSMS until October 2026, and Delivered before that, when it was renamed TextKit. The company, the service and the terms did not change. API keys issued under the old names keep working.

## Where to look next [...] ## Where to look next

 Pricing: every rate, on one page
 Security: the controls built into the product
 Legal center: terms, messaging policy, privacy, DPA, subprocessors and data retention
 Status: live health of the API

## Frequently asked questions

### Is there a free plan?

Yes. Free test keys run every endpoint with simulated delivery, and the Developer plan includes 5 free test texts, with no card.

### Does TextKit support voice or WhatsApp?

No. TextKit is SMS only, and it delivers only in the United States and Canada.

### Do API keys issued under SimpleSMS still work?

Yes. API keys issued under SimpleSMS or Delivered keep working; the company, the service and the terms did not change.
